bom: SKM LF Driver: 125 kHz transmission antenna
SKM Network Interface: Texas Instruments TCAN4550

tara_matrix.damage_scenario: Unauthorized extraction of the AES-128 key, allowing cloning of the key fob or calculation of valid responses.
tara_matrix.threat_scenario: Side-channel attack (e.g., power analysis, electromagnetic analysis) on the Key Fob's NXP PCF7953 MCU to extract the hardcoded AES-128 key.

tara_matrix.damage_scenario: Tampering with the AES-128 key or cryptographic calculations within the Key Fob firmware.
tara_matrix.threat_scenario: Physical tampering/reverse engineering of Key Fob to modify firmware or key storage.

tara_matrix.asset: SKM LF Driver / Key Fob LF Antenna (LF Communication)
tara_matrix.damage_scenario: Eavesdropping on LF challenge to gain information about cryptographic process or vehicle status.
tara_matrix.threat_scenario: Attacker uses an LF receiver to capture the 125 kHz challenge signal.

tara_matrix.asset: Key Fob UHF Transmitter / SKM UHF Receiver (UHF Communication)
tara_matrix.damage_scenario: Relay attack where LF challenge and UHF response are relayed over long distances.
tara_matrix.threat_scenario: Attacker uses two devices to relay the LF challenge to the key fob and the UHF response back to the vehicle, extending the operational range.

tara_matrix.asset: Key Fob UHF Transmitter / SKM UHF Receiver (UHF Communication)
tara_matrix.damage_scenario: Jamming of 433 MHz UHF frequency, preventing Key Fob communication and legitimate access/start.
tara_matrix.threat_scenario: RF jamming using a cheap jammer.

tara_matrix.damage_scenario: Tampering with SKM firmware, allowing unauthorized validation bypass or control of vehicle functions.
tara_matrix.threat_scenario: Physical access and flashing malicious firmware onto the SKM MCU.

tara_matrix.asset: Vehicle CAN Bus / BCM / ECU (CAN Frames for Unlock/Start)
tara_matrix.damage_scenario: Spoofing of the unencrypted CAN frame to the BCM to unlock doors or enable engine start.
tara_matrix.threat_scenario: Attacker gains physical access to the Vehicle CAN Bus (e.g., via OBD-II port) and injects crafted CAN messages to unlock doors or enable engine start.

tara_matrix.damage_scenario: Battery depletion, rendering the key fob inoperable.
tara_matrix.threat_scenario: Normal wear and tear, or user negligence in replacement.

security_goals.goal: The AES-128 key stored in the Key Fob microcontroller shall be protected against unauthorized extraction via side-channel attacks to a very low level of feasibility.
The Key Fob firmware and cryptographic calculations shall be protected against unauthorized modification and physical tampering to ensure integrity.

security_goals.related_asset: Key Fob UHF Transmitter / SKM UHF Receiver (UHF Communication)
security_goals.goal: The PEPS system shall detect and prevent relay attacks to an acceptable level, preventing unauthorized vehicle access and start.
The SKM microcontroller's firmware shall be protected against unauthorized modification or flashing to maintain system integrity and prevent bypass of security functions.

security_goals.related_asset: Vehicle CAN Bus / BCM / ECU (CAN Frames)
security_goals.goal: The CAN frames used for critical functions like unlocking doors and enabling engine start shall be protected against spoofing and unauthorized injection to ensure authenticity and integrity.
